definition: Distinct customer accounts active at the end of the selected period.
source: CRM account master; contract & billing system.
calcNote: Include active customer relationships with at least one in-scope product.
rules: Exclude prospects, test accounts, internal tenants and duplicates. Apply product, region and segment filters as of period end.

definition: Portfolio-level average of account health scores on a 0–100 scale.
source: Health scoring mart fed by CRM, product telemetry, support, VoC, billing and Customer Success data.
rules: Exclude accounts without the minimum required signals; show coverage separately. Do not silently convert missing scores to zero.

definition: Predicted renewal-health indicator combining behavioral, engagement, commercial and feedback signals.
source: Health scoring mart; upstream internal systems listed above.
calcNote: In this build the score is the complement of the Random Forest churn risk score from model_scores; capped at 0 and 100.
rules: Recommended outcome label: renewal within the defined horizon. Version the model, features, training window and threshold table.

definition: Calendar days since an account's latest qualifying activity as of the governed snapshot date.
source: Product telemetry warehouse; Customer Success platform only as a documented fallback for non-digital accounts.
rules: Define qualifying activity and fallback precedence. Lower raw values are better; reverse the quintile so score 5 is most recent. Preserve Unknown when no valid activity exists.

definition: Distinct active days with qualifying product activity during the trailing 30 days.
source: Product telemetry warehouse joined to the CRM account master.
rules: Deduplicate same-day events and exclude bots, tests and passive/system events. Use a cohort-aware scoring distribution.

definition: Finance-approved recurring revenue associated with the account at the as-of date.
source: Contract & billing system; Finance-approved revenue mart.
formula: SUM(active account ARR in reporting currency)
rules: Use approved ARR and FX policies, remove duplicate contract lines and state whether account hierarchy roll-up is parent or child.

definition: Three 1–5 dimension scores and a versioned action segment used to prioritize engagement and value.
source: RFM feature mart built from telemetry, CRM and Finance-governed revenue.
calcNote: Recency is reverse-scored; Frequency and Monetary are ascending cohort quintiles.
rules: Do not collapse to a simple total for actioning. Segment on R/F behavior, then use M to prioritize exposure. Version cohort, cut points and segment rules.

definition: Accounts in Fair, Poor or Critical health bands; count and share of scored accounts.
source: Health scoring mart; CRM account master.
rules: Current bands: Fair 40–59, Poor 20–39, Critical 0–19. The denominator is scored accounts, not all accounts, unless explicitly labeled.

definition: Recurring revenue lost from customers that fully churned during the trailing twelve months.
source: Contract & billing system; Finance-approved revenue mart.
rules: Use constant-currency ARR where required. Exclude contraction from logo churn; define reactivations and acquisitions consistently.

definition: Recurring revenue retained from the opening customer cohort after expansion, contraction and churn.
source: Contract & billing system; Finance-approved revenue mart.
formula: (opening ARR + expansion − contraction − churn) / opening ARR × 100
rules: Exclude new-logo revenue after the cohort start. Use Finance-approved FX and ARR policies.

definition: Count and percentage of scored accounts in each health band.
source: Health scoring mart.
rules: Excellent 80–100; Good 60–79; Fair 40–59; Poor 20–39; Critical 0–19. Percentages should sum to 100% subject to rounding.

definition: Average score for each day or week in the selected range.
source: Historical health-score snapshot table.
rules: Use one score per account per snapshot. Backfills must be marked because model-version changes can alter history.

definition: Smoothed health trend using the latest 30 calendar days.
source: Historical health-score snapshot table.
formula: AVG(daily portfolio score over trailing 30 days)
rules: Use available days only after the minimum history threshold; disclose partial windows at the start of a series.

definition: Estimated negative point contribution of a driver to an account or portfolio health score.
source: Model explanation output from internal scoring features; optional external enrichment features.
formula: share(driver) × mean health shortfall of at-risk accounts, share ∝ corr(driver index, risk) × mean adverse z
calcNote: Driver indices are composites of standardized signals (see Drivers page). Association within the model, not causation.
rules: Negative values reduce health. Impact is association within the model, not proof of causation.

definition: Estimated positive point contribution of adoption behaviors to health.
source: Product telemetry, Customer Success, enablement data; optional enrichment.
formula: share(driver) × (mean health of Excellent/Good − mean health of at-risk accounts)
rules: Compare only within the same model version and cohort. Positive contribution does not guarantee renewal.

definition: Distinct accounts currently eligible for a prescribed intervention.
source: Rules engine using health score, drivers, support cases, renewal date and prior playbook history.
rules: An account may qualify for multiple actions unless the dashboard applies a priority/deduplication rule.

definition: Recurring revenue scheduled to renew within 90 days of the selected as-of date.
source: Contract & billing system.
rules: Include open renewals only. Convert currencies with the approved reporting rate and prevent duplicate contract-line aggregation.

definition: Number of distinct renewal opportunities in the selected horizon.
source: Contract & billing system; CRM renewal opportunity records.
rules: Do not count contract lines as separate renewals unless that is the agreed grain.

definition: Renewal pipeline amount assigned to the latest health band for each account.
source: Contract & billing system joined to latest health-score snapshot.
formula: SUM(renewal ARR) grouped by health band
rules: Use the latest score on or before the as-of date. Flag unscored renewal value separately.

definition: Renewal value and share associated with accounts scoring below 40.
source: Contract & billing system; health scoring mart.
rules: The value and percentage must use the same renewal horizon and currency basis.

definition: Renewal value and share associated with accounts scoring 60 or above.
source: Contract & billing system; health scoring mart.
rules: The dashboard label “Best” should be standardized to “Excellent” to match the health-band taxonomy.

definition: Mean calendar days from the as-of date to active renewal dates.
source: Contract & billing system.
rules: Limit to the selected renewal horizon; exclude closed, cancelled and missing renewal dates.

definition: Share of in-scope accounts or renewals assigned to an active owner.
source: CRM account master and employee directory.
rules: Specify whether the denominator is accounts or renewals. Treat inactive or invalid owner IDs as unassigned.

definition: Distinct active accounts holding each product.
source: CRM account-product relationship; entitlement or contract system.
rules: Multi-product customers may appear in more than one product row; the sum can exceed the portfolio total.

definition: Average health for accounts associated with a selected product.
source: Account-product relationship joined to health scoring mart.
rules: Define how enterprise-level health is allocated when an account owns multiple products.

definition: Share of scored product accounts below the risk threshold.
source: Account-product relationship; health scoring mart.
formula: product accounts with score < 60 / scored product accounts × 100
rules: Keep score grain consistent: product-level score if available, otherwise label as account-level health.

definition: Net revenue retention for the opening revenue cohort of each product.
source: Finance-approved revenue mart; contract product mapping.
formula: product cohort ending ARR / product opening ARR × 100
rules: Allocate bundles using the Finance-approved product revenue rule.

definition: Count of at-risk accounts assigned to each reporting region.
source: CRM region mapping; health scoring mart.
formula: COUNT(DISTINCT account_id where score < 60) by region
rules: Use a governed account-to-region mapping and an “Unknown” bucket rather than dropping unmapped records.

definition: Open, unreviewed alerts generated by score or signal thresholds.
source: Alert & workflow store.
rules: Deduplicate repeated events; show severity and aging. “Mark reviewed” changes status, not underlying risk.

definition: Percentage decrease in the selected adoption measure versus its comparison period.
source: Product telemetry warehouse.
rules: The adoption measure (active users, frequency or feature breadth) and comparison window must be stated in the alert.

definition: Accounts whose health score increased after a completed ROI intervention.
source: Customer Success intervention log; historical health-score snapshots.
rules: Define pre/post windows and improvement threshold. Treat as observational unless a causal design is used.

definition: Count of governed source systems contributing active features to the model.
source: Data catalog and model feature registry.
rules: Count only sources with data used in the current production model version.

definition: Count of active engineered features evaluated or served by the scoring pipeline.
source: Feature store / model registry.
rules: Distinguish raw fields, engineered features and features used by the final model.

definition: Cadence and next scheduled run of the health scoring pipeline.
source: Pipeline scheduler and orchestration logs.
rules: Show last successful refresh and data-through date; do not infer freshness from schedule alone.

definition: Plain-language quality indicator based on model validation and account-level data sufficiency.
source: Model registry, validation report and feature-availability checks.
rules: Define “High/Medium/Low” thresholds. Do not present a generic confidence label without a measurable criterion.

definition: Distinct active accounts classified as Enterprise, Mid-Market or SMB.
source: CRM account master and governed segmentation table.
rules: Use effective-dated segment rules to reproduce historical views.

definition: Average health score among scored accounts in a segment.
source: Governed segmentation table; health scoring mart.
rules: Show score coverage by segment to prevent missingness from biasing comparison.

definition: Share of scored accounts below 60 within a segment.
source: Governed segmentation table; health scoring mart.
formula: at-risk scored accounts / scored segment accounts × 100
rules: Use the same health thresholds across segment comparisons unless explicitly recalibrated.

definition: Net revenue retention for the opening revenue cohort in a market segment.
source: Finance-approved revenue mart; governed segmentation table.
formula: segment cohort ending ARR / segment opening ARR × 100
rules: Freeze the segment at cohort start or clearly label dynamic re-segmentation.

definition: Recurring revenue value associated with an account’s renewal record.
source: Contract & billing system.
rules: Display reporting currency and whether the value is ARR, ACV or TCV; the prototype currently uses unlabeled synthetic amounts.

definition: Highest-magnitude adverse model explanation or governed rule for an account.
source: Model explanation output; support, telemetry, VoC and Customer Success features.
rules: Use a readable driver taxonomy and minimum confidence threshold; show “Insufficient data” where appropriate.

definition: Distinct accounts meeting a playbook’s trigger, eligibility and suppression rules.
source: Rules engine, Customer Success platform and alert/workflow store.
rules: Suppress accounts already enrolled, recently completed, opted out or lacking an active owner as defined by policy.
